meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成 GitHub PR 的代码讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要向同事或客户解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes to non-technical stakeholders

howto.what: 装好后,当你给一个 GitHub 拉取请求(PR),Claude 会读取该 PR 的代码改动(diff、提交和文件),并产出一个讲解这段代码变更的视频,例如更新日志、新功能、修复或重构讲解。
howto.when: 当用户给出一个 PR 链接、`<owner>/<repo>#N` 引用,或在已检出的仓库中说「这个 PR」,并要求生成代码变更讲解视频时触发;若意图并非 PR 或不确定,则转交 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个 PR owner/repo#123 做成讲解视频
say.note: Claude 会读取该 PR 的改动并开始生成视频。

say.text: 为这个 PR 生成一个更新日志视频
say.note: 按 PR 的提交和文件生成更新日志讲解。

say.text: 就在当前仓库,把「这个 PR」做成修复讲解视频
say.note: Claude 会先确认当前仓库的 PR 再生成。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you give a GitHub pull request, Claude reads the PR's code changes (diff, commits, files) and produces a video explaining that code change — e.g. a changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a PR URL, an `<owner>/<repo>#N` reference, or says 'this PR' in a checked-out repo and asks for a code-change explainer video; if the intent isn't a PR or is unclear, it defers to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this PR owner/repo#123 into an explainer video
say_en.note: Claude reads the PR's diff and starts building the video.

say_en.text: Make a changelog video for this PR
say_en.note: Uses the commits and files to produce a changelog walkthrough.

say_en.text: In this repo, make this PR a fix-explainer video
say_en.note: Claude resolves the current PR first, then creates the video.
